description: This file defines an Angular service named EnvService that provides environment configuration, such as API base URL and mock data usage, for a browser-based Angular application. It reads build-time or runtime environment variables to determine configuration settings.

classes.name: EnvService
classes.description: A service class providing environment variables like API base URL and mock data toggle, designed for Angular's dependency injection and runtime environment detection.

methods.name: get apiBase(): string | undefined { apiBase
methods.description: Getter that retrieves the base URL for API calls, checking for server-side environment variables and window-injected variables.

methods.name: get useMock(): boolean { useMock
methods.description: Getter that determines whether to use mock data, based on whether the API base URL is defined and non-empty.

ctags.name: ssr
ctags.pattern: /^    const ssr = (typeof process !== 'undefined' && (process as any)?.env?.NG_APP_API_BASE) || un/

ctags.name: w
ctags.pattern: /^    const w = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (window as any) : undefined;$/
